name: Jealousy And Envy
overview: Scripture reveals jealousy and envy as destructive forces that corrupt the heart and spirit, causing deep inner decay as seen in Proverbs 14:30 where envy is likened to the rottenness of bones. The Bible warns that envy is more relentless and cruel than even wrath (Proverbs 27:4), and it leads to vanity and vexation of spirit when one is envied by others (Ecclesiastes 4:4). Believers are called to live honorably and avoid envying others, instead embracing humility and esteeming others above themselves (Romans 13:13; Philippians 2:3), recognizing that envy is contrary to the fruit of a sound Christian life.
